title: Settings
autoSaveHint: General, analysis, AI, and evaluation settings are saved locally; trash path etc. require clicking Save.

general.title: General
general.itemsPerPageHint: Number of images per page in the list
general.autoAnalyzeHint: Automatically run quality analysis when new images are uploaded (blur, brightness, entropy, etc.).

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.writeXmpHint: Write quality score, rating, labels to image XMP. Compatible with Lightroom, Bridge. Requires ExifTool.
analysis.aestheticModeHint: CLIP = local model, no network. AI = use selected model for aesthetic analysis.
analysis.concurrentCountHint: Images analyzed at once. Higher = faster but more CPU/memory. Recommended 3–5.

ai.title: AI
ai.useAiHint: Use AI for deep analysis (description, evaluation, custom questions). Enable when using evaluation questions.
ai.modelHint: Ollama is local, no API key. Others require an API key.
ai.ollamaUrlHint: Local Ollama service URL. Use machine IP if remote.
ai.ollamaModelHint: Select an installed model from the dropdown. If empty, start Ollama and pull models first.
ai.noModels: No models found. Please check if Ollama service is running.
ai.apiKeyHint: For cloud AI services. Keep secure.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.placeholder: No evaluation questions yet. Click below to add.
evaluation.issuePlaceholder: e.g. Is this a mobile screenshot?
evaluation.noOptions: No options yet. Click below to add.

data.title: Data
data.directoryPlaceholder: Enter path and press Enter or click Add
data.directoriesHint: Used for batch import; recursive subdirs supported.
data.trashDirHint: Deleted images move here. Empty = default.
